question: How does the operation of action and time differ between other regions and Bharata?
premises: Action is observed to exist in other places as well.
This is stated in an ancient source.
In those other regions the time is always Treta, while in Bharata the four ages occur.
inference: Other regions may have action but remain fixed in Treta time, whereas Bharata uniquely cycles through the four ages.
uncertainties: The identity of the 'ancient text' is not specified in the verse.
plain_english: Action is also found in other places, as the ancient tradition says; there the time is always Treta, but in Bharata the full cycle of four ages prevails.
